source.method: live DOM computed-styles audit and stylesheet inspection

extracted: light core tokens (background, foreground, muted, muted-foreground, border, ring, surface, surface-foreground)
type scale (display/title/statement clamps, heading steps, 1.625 leading ratio, -0.025em tracking rule)
radius scale (4/6/8/12/16/24/full) with source frequency counts
button primary and secondary, nav geometry
numbered row, FAQ disclosure, nav, table content patterns
derived: entire dark theme (per-token derivation reasoning preserved in the showroom's derivation table)
semantic palette success/warning/danger from Apple's system palette (product lives inside Finder; source blue ≈ systemBlue)
ghost/danger/small/icon button variants, segment, badge, status dots, kbd, avatar
all form controls (field, input, textarea, select, inputgroup, check, radio, switch, slider)
filesystem set: breadcrumb, sidebar, toolbar, filerow, progress, meter, context menu, command palette
feedback set: alert, toast, tooltip, dialog, tabs, empty state, skeleton

intake shims by kit (2026-08-11): additive .dark/[data-kit-appearance="dark"] theme aliases, color-scheme moved from html to :root scope, sp-scoped box-sizing/font/margin resets, sp-scoped reduced-motion rule
quirks: Color tokens are space-separated RGB channels consumed as rgb(var(--x)) or rgb(var(--x) / alpha) — alpha composition is the point; the raw value is not a color
Native theme mechanism is [data-theme] on the root element
Body copy is always grey (muted-foreground); near-black is reserved for headings and control labels
One border width: 1px hairlines carry all structure; no boxes or fills
Flat by default: shadow only where something genuinely floats (menus, overlays), never on cards or buttons
Weight range 400–500; no bold at any size; emphasis is size and color
Mono carries metadata only (numbers, sizes, extensions, keys, section labels); prose never uses it
Pills for controls, 6–8px radius for surfaces; the vocabularies never cross
Blue is functional only: focus ring and streaming state; never decoration
--surface is a section treatment that inverts per theme, not a theme
Every horizontal rule is part of one 1–2px family (tab indicator, progress track, alert rule)

doctrineDeltas.kitValues: 48px standard controls and inputs; 36px small/toolbar controls; 30px menu, sidebar, and segment rows; 26px switch; 24px badges; ~22px check/radio rows
doctrineDeltas.justification: Finder-adjacent desktop density is the source identity; the standard control is above kit minimum, the dense rows are deliberately below it
doctrineDeltas.scope: Legal inside Space products and the Space showroom; never inherited by universal pieces or complete systems

doctrineDeltas.kitValues: sp-skel opacity pulse loops while visible
doctrineDeltas.justification: Loading indication is functional, not decorative; it stops when content arrives and freezes under reduced motion

cautions: Google Sans is not licensable (Google brand face) — substitute Geist, Inter, or Instrument Sans before shipping a product; Google Sans Code (mono) is openly released and carries over
Statement type size is inferred from one 1147px-viewport measurement — verify at a second width if it matters
No data-visualization language exists; the storage meter is the only chart-like element, and the functional-color rule leaves no categorical sequence to build charts from
Dark mode is unvalidated against the source's white-designed imagery; thumbnails may need an inset hairline
The 2px/2px focus ring needs 4px clearance and will crowd 30px rows — tighten offset to 1px in dense contexts or accept overlap
No responsive precedent for the browser shell below 768px; the stack behavior here is an assumption

sans.stack: "Google Sans", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

mono.stack: "Google Sans Code", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace
